workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: The Commission's APR of FY2025-26 (chapter 5) reproduced with the same draft MYT 2025 rules that reproduce NPCL's claim, fed the order's own figures and checked against its printed computations: the loan and equity carried from the true-up's approved closings (599.02, 584.35) with NPCL's capitalisation, which the order adopts, and NPCL's loan rate unrounded (allowed as claimed); income tax on RoE; working capital with the revenue surplus NPCL holds at the beginning of the year set against it (Table 5-32: net negative, so nil interest); and R&M as Reg. 33.7's 5 % of a base the order does not print — Part A's depreciable assets and Part B at the true-up's close (1,073.20 + 889.53), which gives 98.14 exactly (inferred).

record:consumer_contribution.why: the capitalisation of 387.09 is already net of consumer contribution and the GNIDA assets (Table 5-28, D = A − B − C)

record:retired_grants.why: no gross block retired from consumer contribution in NPCL's APR working (F14 H column)

record:retired_acc_dep.why: the retired assets' accumulated depreciation is NPCL's (F14 H37, 8.22); the order prints none but adopts the net loan and equity additions it implies (Tables 5-30, 5-45: claimed = computed)

record:retired_acc_dep_adjustment.why: no adjustment in NPCL's APR working

assumption:loan_interest_rate.why: the rate is NPCL's (F25 H14, 9.8262 %): 'The interest rate is allowed as claimed by the Petitioner' (para 5.7.5, p.194); the order prints it rounded (9.83 %), which gives 67.81, not its 67.79

record:rm_gfa_part_c.why: Part C (assets from 01.04.2025) opens the year at nil

record:rm_gfa_gnida.why: nothing for the GNIDA assets (as in the ARR year, para 6.6.45)
